g.text: End-to-End Orchestration: Actor Responsibilities, Step-by-Step Processing, Database Persistence & Verified Business Outcomes
WORKFLOW 1: CANDIDATE JOB DISCOVERY, APPLICATION & RECRUITER PIPELINE
Dual emails: Candidate confirmation + Recruiter alert
Candidate moves through live recruiter review pipeline
Future profile edits don't alter it
Network drop never rolls back DB
WORKFLOW 2: RECRUITER JOB PUBLISHING, VISIBILITY RULES & 30-DAY CRON EXPIRATION
Stops new submissions while preserving applicant history
Safe to run multiple times daily
WORKFLOW 3: MENTOR APPLICATION, ADMIN APPROVAL & SECURE ACCOUNT ACTIVATION
Elevates user to ROLE: MENTOR + SHA-256 setup token
Receipt confirmation + Secure 24h password setup link
Unified user identity with elevated role & public services
WORKFLOW 4: RECRUITER TEAM MEMBER INVITATION, GRANULAR RBAC & TENANT ISOLATION
SHA-256 tokenHash + 6 Roles + Assigned job scopes
Direct 7-day acceptance link with embedded token
Strict multi-tenant isolation by companyId & assigned jobs
Admin can resend or cancel anytime
All 4 Workflows Verified Against Backend Implementation · Strict Multi-Tenant Scoping · Cryptographic Security
